description: Total cost of doing a Korean home purchase ownership-transfer registration yourself (셀프 등기): acquisition tax with local education and rural special tax (2026 rates by house count and regulated area), national housing bond purchase by standard price bracket (metro/other) and the discount loss when sold immediately, stamp duty on the contract (buyer's half; homes ≤100M exempt), registration filing fee (e-filing 10,000 / e-form 15,000 / paper 18,000), other costs, comparison with an agent fee, and the 60-day deadline steps. Estimate only.

bondDiscount.description: Bond discount rate when sold immediately (e.g. 0.06)

standardPrice.description: Standard (official) price for the bond bracket
